value.value: you are in a lake and you are swimming. You see something shiny at the bottom of the lake. Would you like to take a closer look?

true.value: You inspect it closer. You can now clearly see a bar of gold press latinum! You swim and try to pick it up, but it is too heavy. Do you give up?
Good choice, you probably would have gambled it away anyways.

false.value: You call your friends over, and ask them to bring a net. That's right, in this game you get to have friends. Unlike real life. Once your friends arrive, they try to help you get it. With a lot of team effort, it is lifted onto the land. You say that since you found it, you get to keep it. Your friends disagree and you only get a third of its value. Your friends leave.
Are you stupid? This is supposed to be a fun adventure game, you need to do everything. There could have been a bar of gold down there!

value.value: Once you leave the lake, you can see a forest and a mountain. You came from the forest. Would you like to go that way?

true.value: You stroll through the forest and pass a really big bee. It buzzes. It turns out it was a bumblebee. You keep walking until you see a deer. Will you attack it?
You attack the deer using your weapon.
You miss and the deer runs faster than a horse in a horse race.

false.value: You successfully shot the deer. You stash it into your backpack.
You pass the deer and it runs away.

true.value: You slip on a rock. How stupid of you. After that, you continue out. Once you're out of the forest, you reach your village.

false.value: The mountain is tall, but you don't have your climbing gear, so you can't climb it. You walk next to the mountain until you reach a river. Would you like to walk through it?

true.value: You walk through the river, through the forest, eventually reaching your village.

false.value: You keep walking along the mountain range. You take a break since it is a long walk. You get back up and continue. After a little more walking, you realize you're hungry. You take the pork out of your backpack and eat it. You wash it down with a little beer.
Soon enough, you reach a village. Unfortunately, they do not think you should be there. They send you back to your village.
